title: 民航機噪音認證概念
summary: 以「區分聲學量測、事件指標和法規符合性證據」為主線，在民航噪音合成事件與證據檢查台中依序完成量測組態與指標版本身份、背景能量與事件分離、事件時間積分與SEL教學、音調頻譜與時間窗、事件抽樣及天候代表性及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Distinguish acoustic measurement, event metrics and regulatory evidence in a Synthetic civil-aircraft noise events and evidence bench, progressing through Measurement configuration and metric version, Separating background energy and events, Event integration and illustrative SEL, Tonal spectra and time windows, Event sampling and weather representativeness, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.
